name: Little Big Town
sources: style-research-extended-2 vol.2 country-pop — Little Big Town
notes: Four-part-harmony country — "the vocal blend is the instrument, over sparse, atmospheric production." The kit is "deliberately minimal — many cuts run on brushes, cross-stick, floor-tom-and-shaker or a single dry backbeat, with no cymbal wash," and the entry's rock-side producer "tracks bands live in one room with musicians 'sitting next to each other,' minimal click and minimal overdubs, so model loose timing and a small, close kit" — which is why this model has the lowest quantize strength and the lowest hat fill in the batch, and why no crash lane is authored at all. The harmony claim is the most specific in the entry and it changes the voicing, not just the numerals: the four-chord vocabulary is "voiced as four-part vocal harmony rather than instrumental chords, which puts close-position triads with added 9ths in the vocal stack," so `voicing.style` is close and the ninth share is the highest in this section. The stated four-voice rule — "the melody frequently the second-from-top voice" — is the counter sitting an octave above at a high density. The tempo band is real and extreme: "'Girl Crush' ~60 is among the slowest No. 1s in the modern era." `relatedGenres` claims only the two lanes the entry supports — the country-pop board it is written on, and the pop side of the "sparse, atmospheric production" the entry describes; nothing in the entry touches soul, so no soul id is claimed. ⚠ Confidence is medium (research: high-medium); the per-track readings are [LOW-CONF]. ⚠ The INFERRED parameters are the humanize values, the perc density and the counter ratio. ⚠ **The countermelody reached 974/1000 distinct answers against a floor of 980 (2026-08-17, counter variety floor).** `melody.emptyBarBias` came down from 0.22 to 0.1. The counter's note count is `densityRatio` times the lead's own note count, so a bar the lead leaves empty is a bar the counter has nothing to answer — and one empty region is IDENTICAL to every other one, which is the single thing a seed cannot vary. Measured across this roster the models failing this gate average 0.150 here against 0.030 for the models that pass. ⚠ The value that moved here is INFERRED rather than a researched claim — the entry's Melody/chords line reads "acoustic, baritone/rubber-bridge-style electric, tremolo electric, pedal steel and organ pad; the arrangement leaves large gaps for the harmony to sit in. Four-voice writing rule: lead alternates between the two female and two male voices by song; the other three sing block harmony in close thirds/sixths with the melody frequently the second-from-top voice.", and every claim in it still holds after the change.
